scope: Independent static audit before G1 specs or fits; no G1 data read or method outcome evaluated
resource_reason: The shared queue requires at least 1 GiB host memory headroom after reservation. A reported 4.965 GiB available could not admit a 4 GiB F1 reservation, whereas a 3 GiB reservation leaves approximately 1.965 GiB. The completed F1 B0 seed-zero unit used 0.151 GiB peak RSS; this is not a bound for protected arms.
limitation: The 3 GiB cap is a hard operational ceiling. A successor exceeding it must fail and remain incomplete; this audit does not predict protected-arm memory use or certify numerical results.
condition: R0 must seal a dated G resource amendment and bind its hash in each write-once G1 spec before any G1 unit runs. F1 B0 seed zero stays a separate completed unit; other F1 records remain preserved.
